title.zh: Today, we hacked what we'd set out to hack: the iPhone
title.en: Today, we hacked what we'd set out to hack: the iPhone

current_state.zh: A researcher publishes a detailed account of a successful iPhone hacking effort, covering the exploit chain used to gain deep access to iOS, with community debate on sandboxing, PDF attack surfaces, and the practical limits of jailbreaking under Apple's ecosystem controls.
